title: The Last Item Sold Twice
timing_status: candidate only; replace after human-approved TTS

scenes.narration_beat: At 9:41, the store showed one laptop left.
Two customers clicked Buy at almost the same moment.
Both requests reached the API, and both read stock equals one.
scenes.animation_intent: two request branches, two DB reads 1

scenes.narration_beat: Two confirmations went out. But there was only one laptop.
scenes.animation_intent: two accept receipts vs one product; status conflict

scenes.narration_beat: The check and the update happened separately. Between those steps another request slipped through.
scenes.animation_intent: highlight gap between read and update

scenes.narration_beat: Looking up the stock again in application code wouldn't fix the race.
Instead, the database needs one atomic decision: decrease stock only if above zero.
scenes.animation_intent: assemble conditional SQL; one affected row

scenes.narration_beat: One customer succeeds. One gets out of stock. The decision is indivisible.
scenes.animation_intent: split into success and stock depleted
